title: Swimmer drowning Ballybunion Ladies Beach
description: Swimmer caught in rip at south end of Ladies Beach. Full moon spring tide, W wind 20kts gusting 30kts, sig wave height 2.5m. RNLI Ballybunion launched but casualty recovered on beach.

title: Multiple swimmers rescued Ballybunion
description: Five swimmers rescued after being cut off by rapidly rising tide at the Caves. Spring tide (>4.5m range). WSW 18kts wind. RNLI + coast guard.

title: RNLI callout Ballybunion — swimmer in difficulty
description: Teenager in difficulty in surf zone. Elevated swell 2.0m, strong rip. Neap tide but swell-driven rip. Windy conditions 22kts SSW.

title: Bodyboarder rescued Ballybunion
description: Bodyboarder unable to return to shore against SW wind and rip. Helped by lifeguard. Wind 17kts SW, wave 1.6m, neap tide.

title: Man drowns at Ballybunion
description: Adult male drowned in surf conditions at the Men's Beach. Conditions: W wind 25kts gusting 38kts, wave height 3.2m, spring tide, full moon. Raised pressure gradient gave very localized surf surge.
